sub_graphs.title: EIP-4844: Blob Transaction Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the complete lifecycle of type-3 blob transactions from submission through inclusion in a block

nodes.label: Blob Transaction Received
nodes.description: Node receives a type-3 (0x03) blob transaction via RPC or p2p announcement

nodes.label: Validate Transaction Format
nodes.description: Verify transaction follows EIP-4844 format with required fields including blob_versioned_hashes

nodes.label: Verify 'to' Field Not Nil
nodes.description: Ensure transaction has non-nil 'to' address (blob txs cannot be contract creation)

nodes.label: Transaction Format Invalid
nodes.description: Transaction rejected due to format violations

nodes.label: Validate secp256k1 Signature
nodes.description: Verify transaction signature over keccak256(BLOB_TX_TYPE || rlp(tx_payload_body))

nodes.label: Check Minimum Blob Count
nodes.description: Verify transaction has at least one blob (len(blob_versioned_hashes) >= 1)

nodes.label: Validate Versioned Hash Prefix
nodes.description: Verify all blob_versioned_hashes start with VERSIONED_HASH_VERSION_KZG (0x01)

nodes.label: Blob Transaction Validated
nodes.description: Transaction passed all validation checks

nodes.label: Check Sender Balance Coverage
nodes.description: Verify sender has sufficient balance for execution gas + blob gas fees

nodes.label: Blob Transaction in Mempool
nodes.description: Valid blob transaction waiting in transaction pool for block inclusion

nodes.label: Announce via NewPooledTransactionHashes
nodes.description: Broadcast transaction hash (not full tx) to peers per EIP-5793

nodes.label: Blob Transaction Included in Block
nodes.description: Transaction included in a block, blob data available via sidecar

edges.label: Receive blob tx announcement from peer

external_entities.name: Transaction Submitter
external_entities.description: External user/dApp submitting blob transactions via JSON-RPC endpoint

external_entities.name: Peer Node
external_entities.description: Other Ethereum node announcing blob transaction via eth/68 protocol

sub_graphs.title: EIP-4844: KZG Commitment Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the cryptographic validation of blob data against KZG commitments

nodes.label: Blob Data Received
nodes.description: Raw blob data (128KB per blob) received along with commitment and proof

nodes.label: Compute Versioned Hash
nodes.description: Apply kzg_to_versioned_hash: VERSIONED_HASH_VERSION_KZG + sha256(commitment)[1:]

nodes.label: Versioned Hash Computed
nodes.description: 32-byte versioned hash derived from commitment

nodes.label: Match Against Transaction Hash
nodes.description: Verify computed versioned hash matches blob_versioned_hashes in transaction

nodes.label: Versioned Hash Mismatch
nodes.description: Blob data rejected due to commitment mismatch

nodes.label: Versioned Hash Matched
nodes.description: Commitment matches, proceed to KZG proof verification

nodes.label: Verify KZG Proof
nodes.description: Cryptographically verify blob data matches KZG commitment using point evaluation

nodes.label: KZG Proof Valid
nodes.description: Blob data cryptographically verified to match commitment

nodes.label: KZG Proof Invalid
nodes.description: Blob data rejected, proof verification failed

nodes.label: Blob Data Available
nodes.description: Blob data verified and available for data availability sampling

external_entities.name: P2P Network
external_entities.description: Network gossip layer providing blob sidecars

sub_graphs.title: EIP-4844: Blob Gas Pricing Mechanism
sub_graphs.description: Models the independent blob gas market with exponential pricing based on excess blob gas

nodes.label: Parent Block Header Read
nodes.description: Parent block header with excess_blob_gas and blob_gas_used is available

nodes.label: Calculate Excess Blob Gas
nodes.description: Compute: max(0, parent.excess_blob_gas + parent.blob_gas_used - TARGET_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK)

nodes.label: Excess Blob Gas Computed
nodes.description: Current block's excess blob gas value determined

nodes.label: Calculate Blob Base Fee
nodes.description: Apply fake_exponential(MIN_BASE_FEE_PER_BLOB_GAS, excess_blob_gas, BLOB_BASE_FEE_UPDATE_FRACTION)

nodes.label: Blob Base Fee Determined
nodes.description: Current blob base fee calculated via exponential formula

nodes.label: Check max_fee_per_blob_gas >= base_fee
nodes.description: Verify transaction's max_fee_per_blob_gas covers current blob base fee

nodes.label: Blob Fee Insufficient
nodes.description: Transaction rejected due to insufficient max_fee_per_blob_gas

nodes.label: Calculate Total Blob Gas
nodes.description: Compute: GAS_PER_BLOB (131072) * len(blob_versioned_hashes)

nodes.label: Deduct Blob Fee from Sender
nodes.description: Deduct blob_base_fee * total_blob_gas from sender balance before execution

nodes.label: Blob Fee Burned
nodes.description: Blob fee deducted and burned (not refunded on failure)

nodes.label: Update Block blob_gas_used
nodes.description: Accumulate blob gas used in block header

nodes.label: Check Against MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK
nodes.description: Ensure total blob_gas_used <= MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK (786432)

nodes.label: Block Blob Gas Limit Exceeded
nodes.description: Transaction cannot fit in block due to blob gas limit

sub_graphs.title: EIP-4844: Point Evaluation Precompile
sub_graphs.description: Models the point evaluation precompile (0x0A) for verifying blob data within smart contracts

nodes.label: Contract Calling Precompile
nodes.description: Smart contract calls address 0x0A with point evaluation parameters

nodes.label: Charge 50,000 Gas
nodes.description: Deduct fixed 50,000 gas for point evaluation precompile

nodes.label: Insufficient Gas
nodes.description: Call fails due to insufficient gas for precompile

nodes.label: Parse Precompile Input
nodes.description: Extract versioned_hash, z, y, commitment, proof from 192-byte input

nodes.label: Verify Versioned Hash Matches
nodes.description: Check kzg_to_versioned_hash(commitment) == versioned_hash

nodes.label: Hash Verification Failed
nodes.description: Precompile returns failure, versioned hash mismatch

nodes.label: Verify KZG Point Evaluation
nodes.description: Cryptographically verify that P(z) = y for polynomial P committed to by commitment

nodes.label: Point Evaluation Failed
nodes.description: KZG proof verification failed

nodes.label: Return Field Modulus and Scalar
nodes.description: Return FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_BLOB and BLS_MODULUS as 64-byte output

nodes.label: Precompile Call Successful
nodes.description: Point evaluation verified, constants returned to caller

external_entities.name: Calling Smart Contract
external_entities.description: Contract verifying blob data via point evaluation precompile

sub_graphs.title: EIP-4844: BLOBHASH Opcode Execution
sub_graphs.description: Models the BLOBHASH (0x49) opcode for accessing blob versioned hashes in EVM execution

nodes.label: EVM Executing Blob Transaction
nodes.description: EVM is executing code in context of a blob-carrying transaction

nodes.label: Read BLOBHASH Opcode (0x49)
nodes.description: EVM encounters BLOBHASH opcode in bytecode

nodes.label: Pop Index from Stack
nodes.description: Pop the blob index argument from EVM stack

nodes.label: Check Index Within Bounds
nodes.description: Verify index < len(tx.blob_versioned_hashes)

nodes.label: Index Out of Bounds
nodes.description: Index exceeds number of blobs in transaction

nodes.label: Push Zero to Stack
nodes.description: Push bytes32(0) for out-of-bounds index

nodes.label: Fetch Versioned Hash
nodes.description: Retrieve tx.blob_versioned_hashes[index]

nodes.label: Push Hash to Stack
nodes.description: Push 32-byte versioned hash onto EVM stack

nodes.label: Blob Hash Available on Stack
nodes.description: Contract can now use the blob versioned hash

ambiguities.text: The term 'valid blob' is used without a precise definition of all validity conditions
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'valid blob' means: (1) correct KZG commitment, (2) correct format (4096 field elements), (3) within size limits, (4) proof verifies. This needs verification against implementation.

ambiguities.text: Blobs must be retained for MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS = 4,096 epochs (approximately 18 days)
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume nodes MAY prune blob data after 4096 epochs but SHOULD retain it for at least this period. Exact pruning behavior is implementation-defined.

ambiguities.text: 1.1x base fee bump requirement for mempool replacement is mentioned but not fully specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume blob transactions follow same replacement rules as EIP-1559 with both execution and blob fees requiring 1.1x bump.

implicit_assumptions.description: KZG trusted setup ceremony was performed correctly and the toxic waste was destroyed
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If trusted setup is compromised, attackers could forge KZG proofs for arbitrary data, completely breaking blob data authenticity

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot perform discrete log in BLS12-381 curve or break KZG polynomial commitment scheme
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Ability to break KZG would allow forging commitments and proofs, enabling invalid blob data to appear valid

implicit_assumptions.description: Network can handle 0.75 MB/block additional bandwidth (40% increase over current)
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Network congestion could cause blob propagation delays, affecting block validity and data availability

implicit_assumptions.description: Rollups and data consumers will retrieve blob data within the 18-day availability window
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Data loss for any application that fails to retrieve blobs before pruning, potentially causing irreversible state issues
